label: OpenAI Agents SDK
description: The workflow becomes OpenAI Agents SDK code: an Agent for each AI block (tools, approvals, structured output) and a small flow that runs the other blocks in Python. Any catalog model works, not only OpenAI's. Exports are Python projects with a command-line runner. No saved history, state editing or breakpoints; a paused run lives in memory.

notes.core.set: a line of Python in the generated flow
notes.core.router: Python picks the next step with the same CEL rules
notes.core.join: the flow waits for every branch before going on
notes.core.approval: the flow pauses between steps; the SDK has no approval step of its own
notes.core.human_input: the flow pauses between steps and asks again when an answer does not fit
notes.core.script: your workspace function is called from the flow
notes.knowledge.search: the flow searches the knowledge base; exports search its file with the built-in embedder
notes.core.agent: an edited tool call is sent back to the agent to make again with the new arguments
notes.mw.model_call_limit: becomes the agent's max_turns (model calls in one run of the agent); a per-conversation limit is not kept
notes.core.decide: an Agent with the block's model is asked once (Runner.run) to pick a path and say how sure it is; the decision {choice, confidence, reason} is saved and the flow follows the choice (the default path when there is none or it is below the minimum confidence)
